text.title: Semantic Games
text.production_notes: Industrial trap beat with distorted sliding 808s, metallic percussion hits, aggressive hi-hat triplets, glitch textures and noise sweeps, Mechanical synth stabs and dark pads, Verses sparse with sudden beat dropouts before wordplay punchlines, Hooks heavy with layered distortion and crowd chants
text.vocal_notes: Aggressive trap delivery with rapid triplet flows and dense internal rhymes, Confrontational tone with sarcastic emphasis on punchlines, Industrial distortion on certain phrases, Occasional shouted ad-libs (Facts! / Say what?! / Gate! / Keep!), Hook delivered with chant-style repetition and layered gang vocals
